[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop unmarked tests from blocking full inventories[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]marker-evidence[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]marker-evidence: make the capture plugin ignore marker-based deselection[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of tests that cannot produce PNG goldens. Mark the stray [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]startup-regression module as visual and add a static guard so no test [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]module under a visual root misses the marker.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-node salvage, recovery retries, and partial apply[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]salvage[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]salvage: in update mode, trust captures per test node instead of per [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run. Rerun failed or lost nodes a bounded number of times, apply every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trusted change, and skip the rest with warnings under a new `partial` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]status. Downgrade whole-run evidence problems to "stale removal skipped"[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and exit 0.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-golden determinism agreement[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]verify-agreement[dim] · [dim][/dim]after salvage[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify-agreement: replace the all-or-nothing determinism verification [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with per-golden agreement voting over bounded serial re-verification. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Apply agreed captures and skip unstable goldens with warnings.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Lock waiting and worker-count translation[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]invocation[dim] · [dim][/dim]after salvage[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]invocation: wait (bounded) for the checkout-local maintenance lock [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of refusing at once. Translate `-n/--numprocesses` selector [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]arguments into the governed `SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS` request instead of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]letting pytest reject them.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the partial-success contract and prove a full run[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after marker-evidence, salvage, verify-agreement, invocation[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: update the Justfile comments, tool help, and developer docs for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the new exit contract. Record the needed memory-note changes as a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]follow-up, then prove that a real full update run exits 0 on this host.[/#D7D7AF]
